scene_excuse_office.title: Room 404: The Bureaucratic Cavern
scene_excuse_office.dialogue: Sharma rubs his temples. 'You have no idea what it's like. Yesterday a man said his alarm clock was set to Martian standard time. The robot rejected it and sent the police. What excuse are you filing?'
suggested_actions: File the Quantum Dog affidavit with the robot
Tell Sharma the brutal honest truth

file_quantum.response_dialogue: EXCUSE-BOT's red eye widens: 'QUERY: Did the canine consume the material in a superposition state?'

scene_bot_confrontation.title: EXCUSE-BOT Processing Chamber
scene_bot_confrontation.dialogue: BZZT! 'Logically impossible. If the homework was consumed in Universe A, why is the carbon footprint documented in Universe B? DEFINE PLAUSIBILITY!'
suggested_actions: Admit you were actually just asleep
